purpose: Historical controlled evaluation only; never current news or publishable assets.

cases.trigger: Apple announces iPhone 16 and iPhone 16 Plus.

objectives.info: Explain one useful Camera Control detail.
objectives.topic: Why close-up phone photography is interesting: macro capability, without invented optical claims.
objectives.story: Tell the real January 2007 first-iPhone introduction: three device roles in one. No invented backstage drama.

facts.text: Apple announced iPhone 16 and 16 Plus on September 9, 2024, with the A18 chip and Camera Control.
Camera Control gives a new way to interact with the camera system.
The new Ultra Wide camera enables macro photography.
The 48MP Fusion camera offers a 2x option.
On January 9, 2007, Steve Jobs introduced the first iPhone at Macworld in San Francisco.
The product combined a mobile phone, a widescreen iPod and an internet communications device.
The interface used finger-driven multi-touch.
It offered an on-screen QWERTY keyboard.
The original model had a 2-megapixel camera and a 3.5-inch display.
Apple planned a June 2007 US release, followed by Europe later in 2007 and Asia in 2008.

cautions: Announcement date is not worldwide retail availability.
Do not imply future AI features were all available at launch.
Historical first-iPhone images must not be passed off as iPhone 16.

cases.trigger: Riyadh Metro inauguration, with phased opening of its network.

objectives.info: The surprising depth of STC Olaya Station.
objectives.topic: Explore the scale and design of an interconnected metro network, without claiming all lines opened together.
objectives.story: Follow the documented start of Mneefah tunneling in 2015 toward the 2024 inauguration; no invented incidents or completion dates.

facts.text: The Riyadh Metro inauguration took place on November 27, 2024, with phased opening.
The network has six lines and 85 stations.
STC Olaya Station extends more than 100 feet underground.
KAFD Station has an undulating roof.
The BACS consortium was responsible for the Blue and Red lines, totaling 63.1 kilometers and 40 stations.
Bechtel reported the start of Line 1 tunneling on July 7, 2015.
The first tunnel boring machine was named Mneefah.
The machine name honored a horse belonging to the founder of Saudi Arabia.
The planned excavation rate was an average of 100 meters per week; this is a target, not a verified achievement.
Seven machines were planned to excavate more than 35 kilometers of tunnels.
Agreement on the central-city alignment was secured before detailed design.

cautions: Do not confuse inauguration with all lines starting passenger service.
Do not describe planned capacity as actual ridership.

cases.trigger: NASA confirms Voyager 1 has reached interstellar space.

objectives.info: A Voyager 1 signal took about 17 hours to reach Earth in September 2013.
objectives.topic: How a distant spacecraft communicates: low-power radio, slow data, enormous antennas.
objectives.story: The real detective story of confirming an earlier crossing using plasma waves after a solar eruption.

facts.text: NASA announced Voyager 1’s interstellar arrival on September 12, 2013.
At that time, a signal from Voyager 1 took about 17 hours to reach Earth.
Voyager signals were emitted at about 23 watts; instrument data typically traveled at 160 bits per second.
NASA received the data using 34-meter and 70-meter Deep Space Network antennas.
Voyager 1 lacked a working plasma sensor, requiring another way to locate the craft.
A March 2012 solar eruption reached its location in April 2013 and excited plasma oscillations.
On April 9, the plasma wave instrument detected oscillations indicating plasma over 40 times denser than in the outer heliosphere.
Scientists then found weaker oscillations in October and November 2012 data.
The analysis placed arrival in August 2012; the team generally accepted August 25 as the crossing date.
Both Voyager craft launched in 1977 and visited Jupiter and Saturn.

cautions: All distances, radio delay and spacecraft status are historical as of September 2013.
Interstellar arrival is not a claim that every definition of the solar system has been left behind.
Spacecraft artist illustrations must be labelled; they are not documentary photos from deep space.
